name: Meta Beaver Dam data center
summary: Meta data center campus of more than 700,000 square feet in Beaver Dam, Wisconsin, announced in November 2025 as a USD 1 billion investment and described as optimized for Meta's AI workloads. Meta's fact sheet and location list now give the investment as USD 1 billion or more, and the list gives 2025 as the groundbreaking year. Meta says it planned its energy needs with Alliant Energy and pays the full cost of the power used, and it refers readers to Mortenson for construction information. Meta has not published a power capacity or an opening date.

location.note: City point from OpenStreetMap Nominatim; Meta names the city but no site or road.

notes: The status rests on two undated Meta pages: the U.S. location list, which gives 2025 as the groundbreaking year, and the fact sheet, which describes the data center in the future tense. status_as_of is therefore the date both were read (2026-10-09). The fact sheet PDF shows no publication date; its embedded file creation date is 2026-09-01.
